definitions.gloss: to admire, to appreciate, to take pleasure in the beauty of
definitions.explanation: To appreciate or take pleasure in the beauty of nature, art, or other aesthetically pleasing things. A somewhat literary or elevated word that conveys mindful, unhurried appreciation.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}を{愛|め}でながら{酒|さけ}を{飲|の}んだ。
examples.english: We drank sake while admiring the moon.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{咲|さ}いた{紅葉|もみじ}を{愛|め}でるのが、{秋|あき}の{楽|たの}しみのひとつだ。
examples.english: Admiring the autumn leaves blooming in the garden is one of the joys of fall.

notes:
{愛|め}でる is a literary and refined verb for appreciating beauty, especially in nature.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: ～を{愛|め}でる

ASPECT (ている):
{愛|め}でている describes the ongoing act of appreciating beauty.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花|はな}を{愛|め}でる: to admire flowers
- {月|つき}を{愛|め}でる: to admire the moon
- {紅葉|もみじ}を{愛|め}でる: to admire autumn leaves
- {桜|さくら}を{愛|め}でる: to admire cherry blossoms

RELATED:
The word {愛|め}でたい (auspicious, happy) is derived from the same root. The noun form {愛|め}で (appreciation, admiration) exists but is rare in modern usage.

REGISTER:
Slightly literary and elevated. In everyday speech, {鑑賞|かんしょう}する (to appreciate) or {楽|たの}しむ (to enjoy) are more common, but {愛|め}でる carries a distinctly Japanese aesthetic sensibility.
